findings.title: Report export splices a sort column into ORDER BY
findings.summary: The sort column reaches the SQL text unquoted, unlike every other identifier.
findings.fix: Quote the column and allow-list sortable columns; add a hostile-column test.

refuted.control: the SSRF guard re-validates every attempt (example-repo/src/Http/RetryingClient.php:84)

_comment: decision is written only by `wfl audit:sign` (the maintainer, from /audit or a terminal): {choice: fix|accept|post-v1, reason, residual_risk, by, at, via: cockpit|terminal, subject}. accept and post-v1 need a reason and the residual risk; subject fingerprints the finding, so a decided finding that changes fails `wfl audit:check`. status follows the decision: open | fixed | accepted | deferred. fixed_by is written by `wfl audit:fixed`: {repo, commit, at}, after a HOLDS fix-check. Every verified candidate appears once: as a finding's id, in a finding's duplicates, or in refuted.
